categories.label: Schools & tutoring
categories.blurb: Admissions help, bus, and extra classes.

categories.label: Insurance
categories.blurb: IPMI and local hospital plans for EP families.

listings.name: Pacific Prime
listings.blurb: Independent health-insurance broker used by a large share of EP families. Compares Cigna, Allianz, AXA, Now Health.

listings.name: Cigna Global
listings.blurb: International medical insurance with worldwide cover — useful if you still treat at home.

listings.name: Allied Pickfords
listings.blurb: Corporate relocation staple. Packing, pets, and destination services.

listings.name: Santa Fe Relocation
listings.blurb: End-to-end moves and immigration support for corporates.

listings.name: Asian Tigers Mobility
listings.blurb: Regional specialist. Strong on Asia-to-Singapore lane.

listings.name: PropertyGuru
listings.blurb: The default listing portal. Start here, then shortlist two agents who actually pick up.

listings.name: 99.co
listings.blurb: Map-first search. Better than PropertyGuru for walking the neighbourhood.

listings.name: OrangeTee Expat Desk
listings.blurb: Agency desk that actually handles overseas buyers and EP tenants.

listings.name: DBS Bank
listings.blurb: Easiest first account for many EP holders. IPA letter often accepted. Best app.

listings.name: OCBC
listings.blurb: 360 account for salary credit. Strong cards. Singpass onboarding.

listings.name: UOB
listings.blurb: One Account and regional travel perks. Fine second bank.

listings.name: HSBC Singapore
listings.blurb: Useful if you already bank with HSBC at home. Premier thresholds apply.

listings.name: Wise
listings.blurb: Mid-market FX for sending money home. Not a replacement for a local bank.

listings.name: YouTrip
listings.blurb: Local multi-currency card. Good for travel around ASEAN.

listings.name: Singtel
listings.blurb: Coverage king. Prepaid tourist SIMs at Changi, postpaid 5G from the low S$20s.

listings.name: SIMBA
listings.blurb: Aggressive data plans. Check coverage in your exact condo before porting.

listings.name: Circles.Life
listings.blurb: Digital telco, no shop queue. Fine if you live in well-covered areas.

listings.name: ViewQwest
listings.blurb: Independent fibre. Often the value pick for 1–2.5 Gbps at home.

listings.name: MyRepublic
listings.blurb: Fibre and mobile. Easy online signup once you have an address.

listings.name: Raffles Hospital
listings.blurb: Private hospital + GP network. Straightforward for insured expats.

listings.name: Mount Elizabeth (Orchard / Novena)
listings.blurb: The private-hospital names most IPMI cards recognise.

listings.name: Gleneagles Hospital
listings.blurb: Napier Road private hospital. Convenient for D9/D10.

listings.name: Singapore Medical Group clinics
listings.blurb: Island-wide specialists. Use for referrals, not A&E.

listings.name: Tanglin Trust School
listings.blurb: British curriculum, Portsdown. Waitlists — start the file before you land.

listings.name: Singapore American School
listings.blurb: Woodlands campus. Factor the north commute into your housing search.

listings.name: UWCSEA
listings.blurb: Dover and East campuses. IB continuum, high demand.

listings.name: Drew & Napier — Employment
listings.blurb: For when an EP or employment dispute is not a blog-post problem.

listings.name: TSMP Law — Immigration
listings.blurb: PR, appeals, and corporate passes. Not a form-filler mill.

listings.name: Homekeeper / HelperChoice
listings.blurb: FDW matching. Budget S$850–1,200 salary plus levy and insurance.

listings.name: IKEA / HipVan / Castlery
listings.blurb: Most EP leases are unfurnished or 'partial'. These three cover 80% of first-month setups.

listings.name: The American Club
listings.blurb: Claymore Hill. F&B, pool, and a ready-made network. Membership wait and fees apply.

listings.name: The Tanglin Club
listings.blurb: Stevens Road heritage club. Proposer often required.

listings.name: WeWork / JustCo / The Great Room
listings.blurb: Hot desks if your EP employer is flexible or you are PEP/ONE Pass.

listings.name: ActiveSG
listings.blurb: Public gyms and pools. Cheap, island-wide, book in the app.
